message.content:
In the community discussion regarding the renovation of the new garden, multiple entities propose adding elements that can enhance the play area for children. Specifically, Arthas Menethil suggests adding a small water feature to the garden, describing it as a "nice focal point and bring some tranquility to the space." Additionally, Muradin Bronzebeard expresses interest in having a fountain, stating that it "could add a nice touch and be visually appealing, while also being relatively easy to maintain."

Regarding outdoor games, playing games is suggested as a way to engage participants and add fun elements to the picnic experience, which is mentioned under the "Games" category. Therefore, both Arthas Menethil and Muradin Bronzebeard propose the addition of a water feature, while the suggestion of outdoor games falls under the broader "Games" category.
